assessor: Anthropic Claude (Opus 5.5), one dependent AI assessor in this interactive session, for the 299 new hybrid candidates; the 1,390 inherited labels are the unchanged OpenAI Codex source-reviewed set. No human labels.
evidence_scope: First pass over all 299 new pairs using stored titles, types, descriptions and the first 330 characters of bulletin/metadata text from the frozen 3,424-document corpus, with the inherited grades of same-series releases shown for consistency. Live MCP evidence is reserved for the sequential review.
limitations: A second, different AI model grades the new pairs while the inherited labels come from the earlier Codex review; neither is independent and both know the implementation. No human validation or inter-rater agreement. The assessor also implemented the hybrid systems and saw lower-bound pilot scores before grading. Pooled recall is not exhaustive corpus recall; repeated historical releases are separate IDs.

rubric.2: Stored evidence directly supports the target concept and requested population/geography or explicitly advertises a suitable breakdown.
rubric.1: Related context, a narrower/broader measure, revisions, or unconfirmed requested scope; not sufficient as a direct answer.
rubric.0: Unrelated or a different/misleading measure, including enterprise births versus baby births and resident foreigners versus tourists.
